description: Source code for the F1-U split connector handling GTP tunnels, session management, and bearer creation/removal in a 5G network component.

classes.name: f1u_split_gateway_du_bearer
classes.description: Represents a GTP tunnel bearer at the F1-U split gateway, manages GTP session binding.

classes.name: f1u_split_connector
classes.description: Main class managing F1-U split connection, session creation, and bearer management.

methods.name: f1u_split_gateway_du_bearer::get_bind_address
methods.description: Retrieves the bind address for the GTP session.

methods.name: f1u_split_connector::create_du_bearer
methods.description: Creates a new DU bearer with specified parameters, sets up GTP tunnels and demux.

methods.name: f1u_split_connector::remove_du_bearer
methods.description: Removes an existing DU bearer and cleans up associated resources.

methods.name: f1u_split_connector::get_du_bind_address
methods.description: Returns the external bind address for a DU GNB, either auto or specified.
